Coordinates derive from the CC0 RCSB CCD CLR ideal model; its eight declared stereocenters are preserved by the atom-name map and mmCIF round trip.

The one-based head index 28 resolves to hydroxyl O3 in this exact coordinate asset; O3 bonds to C3 and H3'. The CHL1 starting footprint is 38.2 Å², consistent with a 37.22 Å² projected heavy-atom van der Waals silhouette of this template and published X-ray cross section. It estimates an initial mixed-packing count only, not a transferable partial or equilibrium area.
630 Å³ is an experimental approximate partial molecular volume for cholesterol in fluid phosphatidylcholine bilayers, not a universal local or mixture volume.
Nominal pH 7.0 is a static aqueous reference, not a site-specific pKa determination.
Every histidine state, consequentially uncertain side-chain state, disulfide assignment, and nonstandard terminus requires case-specific review; proximity alone does not establish a bond.
ARG and TYR use their standard ff19SB residue templates; this catalogue does not introduce alternative variants for them.
Only canonical protein chemistry without retained non-protein partners is covered; a successful force-field match does not establish membrane placement or biological correctness.
This is a coarse screen for gross covalent-distance and consecutive peptide C-N discontinuities on the exact selected and prepared atom graph.

The 0.75-2.25 Å covalent and 1.0-1.728 Å peptide ranges are deliberately broad local policy choices anchored to published target geometry and the identified ff19SB equilibrium bond-length range; they are not universal outlier scores.
No bond-angle, chirality, peptide-planarity, rotamer, pair-specific steric-clash, experimental validation, prediction-confidence, or biological-assembly judgment is made by these two measurements.
An unavailable required measurement, incomplete correspondence, or an unrepresentable chemical state prevents positive protein preparation.

Membrane-local assessment establishes exact neutral lipid or sterol molecular representations and coherent independently specified physical leaflets only; it does not predict phase, miscibility, native biological sidedness, leaflet stress, or completed-system qualification.
Arbitrary coherent fractions are accepted as stated intentions and exact representable combinations, not as blanket evidence that every mixture or asymmetry is scientifically suitable.
CHL1 has an identified complete-provider construction representation. Actual packed cholesterol counts, leaflet identity and any piercing cleanup are checked in the construction attempt.
The fixed target is 0.15 M NaCl and optional equilibration target is 303 K; published single-component volume or area references at other temperatures cannot be treated as those achieved conditions.
The position is assessed for exact geometry and revision correspondence; the selected arrangement remains a researcher-defined study model.
The 23 Å leaflet envelope is a schematic frame for the general builder, not a measured equilibrium bilayer thickness.

construction.approximationStatement: PACKMOL-Memgen 2026.3.25 derives starting populations and the periodic cell from selected leaflet ratios and the positioned prepared construct; its packing, hydration, charge-compensated 0.15 M nominal salt, Amber parameterization and two conditioning passes produce an accounted starting state for the separate final OpenMM minimization. Derived counts and cell are starting-model estimates, not equilibrium observations.
